context: Manip Leythim is a Flaming Fist posted outside the Elfsong who has landed himself in hot water with a wealthy patriar, Hurlbut Hhune. He says he and Hurlbut’s daughter Henrietta were secretly engaged until her father intervened; Henrietta is now being pushed toward marriage with Derque Rillyn. Hurlbut has apparently sent thugs after Manip, so Manip is nervously begging strangers for a healing potion and trying not to make a scene that would worsen Henrietta’s position. The encounter takes place amid the crowded Elfsong exterior — guards, tavern patrons, and street vendors (like Doora Thumbfoot) provide a tense, watchful backdrop.
